recommendation: Keep the fix. Future decisions to move or consolidate these category codes in THO should be handled under FHIR-53306/FHIR-55335/FHIR-55337 or a successor final tracker, without leaving current built examples pointing at obsolete/nonexistent terminology.hl7.org systems.
issue_request: FHIR-31632 was an Applied/Persuasive Pharmacy change request, approved for R6, asking to bring example medication value set/code system bindings back into FHIR Core from terminology.hl7.org for the medication resource family.
initial_application: Pharmacy approved FHIR-31632 with FHIR-31633 on 2021-04-05. PR HL7/fhir#3896 created the in-core MedicationRequest category CodeSystem/ValueSet and rebound MedicationRequest and MedicationStatement category, while PR HL7/fhir#3911 commit 2571d5b4b2 explicitly said it applied FHIR-31632 and FHIR-50142 while completing FHIR-51726. That left built examples using obsolete terminology.hl7.org medication category systems and left an unbound MedicationStatement category ValueSet source composing from a terminology.hl7.org system.
additional_context: Current active MedicationRequest and MedicationStatement StructureDefinitions bind category to http://hl7.org/fhir/ValueSet/medicationrequest-category, which includes http://hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/medicationrequest-category. FHIR-32825 supports sharing MedicationRequest category vocabulary for MedicationStatement. Later FHIR-53306, Zulip PR review, and PHAR 2025-11-03 minutes discuss possible future THO consolidation, but FHIR-53306 is Triaged and FHIR-55335/FHIR-55337 are unresolved, so they do not supersede the current applied core-source state.
reconciliation: Changed source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest0301.xml, source/medicationrequest/medicationrequest0333.xml, and source/medicationstatement/medicationstatementexample1.xml to use http://hl7.org/fhir/CodeSystem/medicationrequest-category for category codings. Deleted source/medicationstatement/valueset-medication-statement-category.xml because MedicationStatement.category now deliberately uses the shared MedicationRequest category ValueSet and no separate MedicationStatement category CodeSystem remains.
